{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient rows, keeping the one with highest sample_seq
# First, sort by sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_clean = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify the cleaning
print("Original shape:", df.shape)
print("Cleaned shape:", df_clean.shape)

# Check the 'responded' column again after cleaning
print("Responded value counts after cleaning:", df_clean['responded'].value_counts(dropna=False))

# Now, filter for the treatment arm only
treatment_df = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute the fraction of patients who responded in the treatment arm
fraction_responded = treatment_df['responded'].mean()

# Print the result
print("Fraction responded in treatment arm:", fraction_responded)

# Return the fraction
fraction_responded"}
